hints.title: Tally Mismatch Categories
hints.text: Count how many positions have x in s1 and y in s2 (count xy) versus y in s1 and x in s2 (count yx).

hints.title: Check Total Mismatch Parity
hints.text: If the total number of mismatches (xy + yx) is odd, it is impossible to equalize the strings; return -1.

hints.title: Combine Pairs and Remaining Crosses
hints.text: Two xy mismatches need 1 swap; two yx mismatches need 1 swap; one leftover xy and yx requires 2 swaps.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Search algorithms simulating swaps explode exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting xy and yx pairs takes a single linear sweep and constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the swap arithmetic formula: xy // 2 + yx // 2 + (xy % 2) * 2.
complexity.notes: Strings contain only characters x and y.
